label: token right after an early g (t/s g _) OR first copy step re-reading leading 1
explanation: Sparse feature (about 0.05% of steps) made of two unrelated parts. (A) Original phase, about 45% of mass: fires on the token at position 2-3 that directly follows a g (prev_tok=g is 15x lift), strongest when the token before the g is t or s (for example t t g [e], t s g [e]). Inputs e/i/d/l are favored. (B) Copy phase, about 50% of mass: fires on the first copy-phase input (recall_idx=1, where the model re-reads orig(0) and outputs orig(1)). It is strongest when that token is 1 and L is short (3-4), and next outputs t/s/p are favored. The largest activations come from short 1-initial sequences (1 t s <DEL> [1]) and from t t g _. It never fires at t=0-1, at the delimiter, or past recall_idx 2. Within both contexts most matching steps stay silent, so the true trigger depends on more specific hidden-state content than this predicate captures. Precision is low.
